product_metadata.title: Brass Chime Candlestick Candle Holder for 1/2" Diamater Candles
description: Standing just shy of 2" tall, this brass chime candle holder is designed to resemble the traditional bedroom chamberstick, but for our enchanting chime candles. It measures 2 5/8" in diameter and 3 1/4" at its widest point. This candle holder is intended for use with 1/2" wide chime candles
